title: L4 Traveling Telecommunications Tech
description:
L4 Traveling Telecommunications Tech needed ASAP for a position that will be 100% travel for a 1+ year contract!

Our client is looking for L4 Traveling Telecommunications Technicians for a nationwide optical deployment.
  • Have a minimum of 3 years' accumulated experience or equivalent as determined by the Installation Supplier's training process and demonstrated to the TC representative upon request, proficiency in the system (Network Elements 1, 2, 3, and 4) being worked on, or hold a Certificate of Completion from a training facility providing an appropriate curriculum.
  • Be capable of performing the same work operations/job activities as a Skill Level 3 Installer without supervision or direction.
  • Be capable of performing as the Installation Supplier's in-charge person.
  • Be capable of performing additions, removals, and modifications on working equipment and circuits.
Skill Level 4 work operations/job activities may include:
  • Circuit modifications Software additions or upgrades Power transition work Addition or removal of batteries.
  • Addition or removal of circuits on working power distribution sources.
  • Equipment testing and turn-up

Requirements:
  • Must understand and know how to use Microsoft programs and applications on a PC and smart device.
  • Must understand Ethernet and Serial connection requirements and be able to establish PC to Network Elements communications using appropriate interface cable.
  • Must have a smart phone with picture capabilities and the ability to place applications used for work.
  • Must have a smart phone with "Mobile Hotspot” capabilities and the ability to establish smart phone to PC connections for the purpose of assisting with remote support via desktop sharing.
  • Must be able to work alone and with others in a fast-paced schedule.
  • Must be able to take direction and constructive criticism.
  • Must be able to think freely and overcome complex issues.
  • Ability to learn to run scripts and commands for test and turn-up of equipment.
  • Must be able to learn company and customer programs for data collection.
  • Must have the ability to fly and ability to travel 100% for 3 consecutive weeks or more with field breaks as the company needs allow.
  • Must pass criminal and drug tests to gain access badging from the telco customer.
  • Must be able to interface politely with the customer using proper work ethics and etiquette while working under pressure.
  • Must have the ability and aptitude to meet customer start and stop working hours.
  • Must be able to climb ladders and work in tight spaces.
  • Must have their own telecom insulated hand tools.
  • Must know how to use telecom test equipment tools.
    • OTDR
    • Fiber scope
    • Volt Ohm Meter
    • BER test sets
    • Cable test equipment
    • Visual Fault Locator (Ruby reds)
  • Understanding of proper cabling installation and protection techniques.
  • Understanding industry standards for securing cables using waxed 9-cord and Velcro.
  • Understanding of proper fiber types, ends, jumper/JPOI handling and protection.
  • Understanding of proper fiber cleaning and scoping techniques. (Will NOT be required to splice)
  • Knowledge and understanding of DWDM, OME long haul, short haul, up to 100G circuits.
  • Knowledge and understanding of Transport protocols Ethernet and OTN.
  • Knowledge and understanding of mounting equipment in customer central offices, colocation areas, huts, and outdoor enclosures.
  • Ability to make and test Cat-5/6 cables straight and crossover.
  • Ability to see Understand the telecom color codes and wire wrap paired cable.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and understand engineering documents, customer best practices, and manufacturer technical practices.
    • Scope of work
    • Cable run lists
    • Rack Face View (RFV) drawing
    • Signal Flow Diagram (SFD)
    • Circuit drawings
    • Installation instructions
    • Method Of Procedures (MOP) (E-MOPs)
    • Knowledge of AC and DC power.
    • Power Bays, verifying and installing -48V and return leads while protecting live circuits.
    • Must be able to properly strip and crimp DC power leads.
    • Crimping of lugs and H-Taps.
    • Ability to terminate power safely.
    • Use of electrical grease where required.
    • Use of double insulated torque wrench and screwdriver.
    • Able to work steadily in an enclosed power environment.
    • Understanding of AC power and connections.
  • Knowledge of Telcordia GR1275 industry installation standards.
  • Telco equipment manufacturer and customer knowledge is a plus.
    • Ciena
    • Cisco
    • Telecommunication
    • Comcast
    • Telecommunication
    • Enterprise customers
    • GCN customers

title: L3 Traveling Telecommunications Tech
description:
L3 Traveling Telecommunications Tech needed ASAP for a position that will be 100% travel for a 1+ year contract!

Our client is looking for L3 Traveling Telecommunications Technicians
for a nationwide optical deployment.

Roles and Responsibilities:
Have a minimum of 2 years accumulated experience, or equivalent as determined by the  Installation Supplier's training process and demonstrated to the TC representative upon  request, proficiency in the system (Network Elements 1, 2, 3, or 4) being worked on, or  hold a Certificate of Completion from a training facility providing an appropriate  curriculum.

Be capable of performing the following work operations or job activities without supervision or direction:
  • Addition or removal of common systems equipment hardware.
  • Addition or removal of wiring and connections (on non-working equipment only).
  • Lead verification/continuity testing.
  • Analysis of job specifications and drawings.
  • Understand the Scope of Work (SOW) and write comprehensive Job Change Order (JCO) summaries.
  • Provide work assignments to Skill Level 1 and 2 Installers.
  • Prepare a Method of Procedure (MOP).
  • Write Job Information Memorandums (JIMs).
  • Resolve job specification and/or drawing problems.
  • Mark/correct office record drawings.
  • In-process and final quality inspections.
  • Be capable of performing as the Installation Supplier's in-charge person on Common Systems jobs.
  • Not perform Skill Level 4 work operations/job activities unless properly supervised.
  • Not progress to Skill Level 4 without a minimum of 6 years accumulated experience or equivalent as determined by the Installation Supplier's training process.
  • Not perform work operations/job activities on working equipment or circuits unless directly supervised.
  • Lead verification/continuity testing.
  • Not perform Skill Level 3 or 4 work operations/job activities unless properly supervised.

title: Telecommunications Traveling Quality Auditor
description:
Telecommunications Traveling Quality Auditor (100% Travel) needed ASAP for a 1+ year contract!

POSITION SUMMARY:
Inspects, reports, and maintains independent analysis of customer installation projects.  Inspection includes physical installation of telecommunication and transport equipment.
  • This is considered a 100% travel throughout the US
  • Review and report quality of all Engineering Specifications & Installation packages to ensure that they are consistent with and meet all requirements of the customer.
  • This is accomplished by performing audits during installation of the package and immediately after the job ends. Audits include all aspects of the project from engineering and installation. The goal is to find and report issues so that a superior product is delivered to the customer.
  • May require weekend work at times.
  • Telecom Quality inspection knowledge is a must. 5 plus years of telecom installation experience plus years of quality auditing experience.

Major Responsibility
  • Interprets Customer Standards / Practices, T-BASD Drawings, Flashes and Manufacturers and understands documentation of the National Electric Code, and other industry standard documents.
  • Ensures engineering specifications, assignments, and job drawings are in accordance with specifications and that proper documentation is provided.
  • Audits engineering documentation and installation workmanship to ensure accuracy of the information presented.
  • Develops a list of deltas for correction and verifies completed corrections per company standards.
  • Audit customer job site on request, visually inspect pictures that have been uploaded to ensure that customer standards are met. Verify job spec information and documentation is properly and accurately collected and conveyed when necessary.
  • Ability to be at the job site to audit installed equipment to ensure that customer standards are met.
  • Must be AT&T certified or able to pass their tests to become certified.
  • Knowledge of Ciena, Cisco, and other telecom equipment installation.
  • Ability to train technicians while performing installation inspection.

POSITION QUALIFICATIO/REQUIREMENTS:
  • Computer skills, including Microsoft Office and other software applications.
  • 3M & Hilti Fire Stop Certification or knowledge.
  • Ability to fly or operate a motor vehicle, possess valid US Driver's License, and maintain an approved Motor Vehicle Record.
  • Knowledge of Telecommunications and transport equipment installation.
  • Handle confidential/sensitive information with discretion.
  • Excellent communication & good judgment.
  • Organizational skills.
  • Customer service skills.
  • Interpersonal skills.
  • Knowledge of equipment installation, detail engineering, COAR, site survey, knowledge and understanding of power, grounding, and Telephony theory.

title: IT Depot Tech
description:
IT Depot Technician needed for a contract to hire position in Englewood Cliffs, NJ!

We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Depot Technician to manage our end client's depot activities. This role involves handling devices, fulfilling work orders and shipping orders as well as maintaining and updating the Asset Management systems. The Depot Technician is responsible for the smooth operation of all the depot activities and ensuring accuracy and efficiency in all stock handling and reporting.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular stock audits and update Asset Management system.
  • Track inventory levels and maintain accurate records, reporting any discrepancies found.
  • Respond to tickets by picking, packing, and preparing device orders for end user delivery or shipping.
  • Receive, unload, and store incoming devices and depot goods.
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of the warehouse.
  • Follow health and safety procedures at all times.
  • Inspecting and verifying hardware issues on returned devices.
  • Clean-up and reimaging if required of these devices and return to stock.
  • Follow IT policies and procedures to ensure data security and compliance.
  • Maintain accurate records of issues and solutions in the ticketing system.

Requirements:

  • Previous experience in a stock management or warehouse role.
  • Basic knowledge of computer hardware and operating systems.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency in inventory software and Microsoft Excel. Experience with ticketing systems such as ServiceNow
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple tasks under pressure meeting all deadlines.
  • Strong communication and Customer service mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Punctual and reliable.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CompTIA A+ or similar certification.

title: Desktop Support Technician
description:
Onsite Desktop Support Techs needed ASAP for a 6+ month contract position in Atlanta, GA!

Work Hours: either Sunday through Wednesday or Wednesday through Saturday 7:00am - 5:30pm (4x10)

JOB DUTIES DESCRIPTION
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve production problems
  • Ensures client organizations are maximizing the value of the technology platforms and that workflows are operating smoothly at all times
  • Observes system functions to verify correct system operation and surface issues to Product and Engineering teams to improve the product
  • Manage and continuously improve our processes for helping customers, managing the team, and working with the rest of the company.
  • Responds to inquiries concerning systems operation and diagnoses system hardware, software, and operator problems.
  • Environment is Windows 10 and Office 365
  • Documents and tracks detail information about tickets opened in the Support Desk System and conducts required follow up to ensure the issue on the ticket has been successfully resolved
  • Conducts technical research for problem resolution as needed and documents steps taken to resolve an issue, escalates appropriately
  • Coordinates activities with help desk, network services, or other information systems groups
  • Prepare various reports for management and auditing purposes. Provides updates, status, and completion information to manager
  • Manage user provisioning and de-provisioning including accounts, equipment, data handoff, etc.
  • Perform other duties as assigned
